subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). Interface view: an object that does not implement interface-name-1 sets EC-OO-CONFORMANCE (OK 6)). An interface emits as its C# interface and IMPLEMENTS as the class's C# base list (inherited by subclasses), so `is I` is the check. Golden: PB1425VD (implements PB1425VI through PB1425VA) -> DERIVED; PB1425VX -> HANDLED=EC-OO-CONFORMANCE. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
